description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget named CategoryPieChart, which renders a pie chart with labeled segments and a legend. It uses CustomPainter for drawing the pie slices, and dynamically assigns colors to slices. The file references external dependencies such as Flutter Material library and a custom chart models class, and it defines internal widgets for rendering parts of the chart.

classes.name: CategoryPieChart
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that renders a pie chart with labels and a legend based on provided slices.

classes.description: A CustomPainter that handles drawing the pie slices with specified colors.

classes.name: _LegendItem
classes.description: A StatelessWidget for rendering a single item in the chart's legend, including color indicator and label.

methods.description: Determines the color for a slice based on its index, cycling through a predefined color list.

methods.description: Draws the pie slices on the canvas based on slices data, computing angles proportionally.
